annotations.annotation_text: Structural overview of Book III. Joyce planned Book III around the four canonical Roman night watches (vigiliae) dreaming backwards into the future: Shaun before the people (III.1), Jaun's sermon to the rainbow girls (III.2), the inquest and interrogation of Yawn upon the hill of Tara (III.3), and the bedchamber scene of Porter/HCE and ALP (III.4).
sources: Hart, Clive. Structure and Motif in Finnegans Wake. Northwestern University Press, 1962.
Hayman, David. A First-Draft Version of Finnegans Wake. University of Texas Press, 1963.
